title: relay doctor on a fine project exits 1 for other projects
what: Split the output: project checks decide the exit code of doctor <project>; machine-wide ones print under their own heading.
why: relay doctor <project> mixes machine-wide results into a project check: its one FIX was 'rules in sync' for ten other projects, so a good new project looks broken.
failing_case: Trial: relay doctor <tally> printed 21 ok and 1 FIX (rules in sync for alix; arsenal; ... noisegate), exit 1, nothing about tally.
pass_cases: doctor <project> exits 0 when the project is fine, and the machine-wide FIX is shown separately.
